name: SalesTouch
why: A standout sales & marketing tool for everyday users: salesTouch is a LinkedIn MCP server for AI agents.
description: SalesTouch is a LinkedIn MCP server for AI agents. Connect Claude, Codex, ChatGPT or any remote MCP client to https://www.salestouch.io/api/mcp and your agent can find prospects, research people and companies, send invitations and messages, and handle follow-ups through 45 purpose-built LinkedIn tools instead of browser automation. Scoped OAuth, approvals for sensitive actions, daily limits, working hours and a human-paced action queue keep the account under control.
